text: Clearing the garden exposed a stone edge beneath the old tree.
landmark_hint: Look beside the restored garden's old tree.

text: Rainwater flashes strangely beyond the mossy fork.
landmark_hint: Follow the west branch past the split stump.

text: Pip found copper teeth in the roots and marked the place with blue twine.
landmark_hint: Take the east branch toward the bent birch.

text: Mara noticed a sealed packet near the woodland gate's fallen log.
landmark_hint: Search the first quiet turn beyond the gate.

text: The ruin's shadows repeat a three-point shape near its rear stone.
landmark_hint: Study the low slab behind the ruin arch.
